declarations.name: HGPExperiment.mem_coordinateSpace
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] [Fintype Q] (E : Set Q) (v : Q → F),
  v ∈ HGPExperiment.coordinateSpace E ↔ ∀ q ∉ E, v q = 0

declarations.name: HGPExperiment.supportedDim.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] (C B : Submodule F (Q → F)) (E : Set Q),
  HGPExperiment.supportedDim C B E = Module.finrank F ↥(HGPExperiment.supportedLogical C B E)

declarations.name: HGPExperiment.supportedLogical.eq_1
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] (C B : Submodule F (Q → F)) (E : Set Q),
  HGPExperiment.supportedLogical C B E = Submodule.map B.mkQ (C ⊓ HGPExperiment.coordinateSpace E)

declarations.name: HGPExperiment.supportedDim_eq_zero_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Field F] [Fintype Q] (C B : Submodule F (Q → F)) (E : Set Q),
  HGPExperiment.supportedDim C B E = 0 ↔ C ⊓ HGPExperiment.coordinateSpace E ≤ B
